description: React component file defining CardList and DnDKanbanCard components for a Kanban board, supporting drag-and-drop reordering and card management.

methods.name: CardList
methods.description: Main React component for displaying a list of cards within a column, supporting adding, dropping, and reordering cards.

methods.name: handleAddCard
methods.description: Handles adding a new card with form data, updating state and resetting form.

methods.name: DnDKanbanCard
methods.description: Component wrapping a Kanban card with drag-and-drop capabilities for reordering and moving between columns.
